description: Product prices and offer codes for one app from the RevenueCat or Adapty webhook, over the last 365 days: per product and country, the price in force now (currency, local price, since when) and every fixed-price period with its trial starts, new paid subscriptions, trial conversions and revenue, plus each offer code with its first and last day and redemptions. A price change shows up as a new period, so before/after is read period by period. connected=false means neither webhook is connected.

country.description: two-letter country code to narrow to one storefront

product.description: store product id to narrow to one product

name: get_pricing_offers
